crossRefs.note: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and…
His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and…
He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

people.name: Israel

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin
